What these images establish

These are unchanged browser captures of the software, including its quiet neurons, inactive inputs and unverified mission labels. Captions distinguish measured anatomy from modeled activity, engineered controls and historical evaluation results. A pictured flight is not a new benchmark.

No controller training or research runs were started for this gallery. Most captures use the public release; the Flight Lab and outcome captures use the same simulator with a one-line chart redraw fix. The capture manifest records the exact source revision, dimensions and SHA-256 for every original image.

Review the released landing evaluation and controller provenance. The separate Fly Cube design concepts are AI-generated mockups of unbuilt hardware.
